FAQ

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Everything you need to know about Imagio, from setup to customization and usage.

What is Imagio?

Imagio is a wonderful AI platform that helps you easily transform text prompts into digital artwork and creative comics.

How does digital marketing improve efficiency?

Digital marketing automates lead generation and uses real-time data to optimize campaigns, allowing your team to focus on high-value strategy and scaling.

How fast can I generate images?

You can generate stunning images rapidly, usually taking just 2 to 30 seconds depending on your chosen settings.

Is Imagio available on mobile devices?

Yes, absolutely! You can conveniently use Imagio on mobile devices through dedicated iOS and Android apps or web browsers.

Is there a free version available?

Absolutely! You are most welcome to use our free plan to design and publish on a free subdomain.
